title: URAファイナルズ決勝の後に・敗北

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are! Good job today! I have something I want to say to you!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Your racer ran great out there! Seriously, I had chills.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to compete against you guys again! See you at the next Unity Cup!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: I also wanted to say that, um… your racer didn't do so bad out there.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Not that I'm… complimenting you or anything.
